subject: Service continuity safeguard and reliability stipend request for renewal
messages:
From: Asha Reddy <asha@starlend.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@starlend.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent tail latency + renewal conversation

Hi Soojin,

Quick note from our ops desk — this week we saw two tail-latency incidents (spikes around 1.8s P99 for 1-2 hours) that materially impacted our pre-approval flows. We've attached an incident timeline CSV with request IDs.

We're happy with Redwood's feature set overall, but these interruptions make our finance/legal teams nervous as we approach the June renewal. Before we proceed with expanding usage, the procurement team is asking for: 1) a short-term commitment to improved latency SLOs for our region or an explicit mitigation plan; and 2) a one-time "reliability stipend" to offset the customer impact while we evaluate a Dedicated pilot.

Can we get a concrete proposal by next Thursday (2027-04-08)? If needed, Liam can hop on a call to walk through the timeline.

Thanks,
Asha
Asha Reddy
Head of Ops, StarLend
asha@starlend.com

Attachment: incident_timeline.csv

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Reddy <asha@starlend.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent tail latency + renewal conversation

Hi Asha — thanks for the heads-up and for sending the timeline. We've pulled the request ids into our tracing stack and are already matching recent spikes to a batch-scheduling regression we shipped last month.

High-level next steps I propose:
- Immediate: provisional credit (service stipend) to compensate impacted calls while we remediate — we can propose an amount in follow-up.
- Short-term (1 week): rollback the batching change for StarLend's tenant and enable tighter per-tenant batching controls.
- Medium-term: run a Dedicated pilot for the busiest routes (30d) and define an SLO amendment for P99 latency in the contract renewal.

Karthik / Neha — can you validate the rollback approach and cost delta for a 30-day Dedicated pilot that covers StarLend's peak routes? Asha — if you can share a short window for a 30-min call early next week we can align.

Thanks — I'll draft a stipend proposal and an SLA amendment for your legal team to review.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai

Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-starlend-logs

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent tail latency + renewal conversation

We validated the timeline against ingress patterns. Root cause appears to be an aggressive aggregation window in the continuous-batching layer that increased tokenization latency for short requests at peak concurrency. Rollback is low-risk and should restore prior P99s within hours.

Cost considerations for a 30-day Dedicated pilot (rough estimate):
- Reserved pool (NVIDIA-A100 equivalent) scaled to StarLend peak load: $45k/mo pass-through list (we can apply a pilot discount).
- Engineering support + SLO monitoring hook: one-time $6k onboarding fee.
- If StarLend wants a contractual P99 <= 650ms for specific routes, we'd include an operational surcharge to cover capacity guarantee (we should propose a blended add-on, ~15% above pilot list).

I suggest proposing a short-term stipend equivalent to 4 weeks of average per-token cost (credited against renewal) to acknowledge impact while we validate Dedicated. That should be meaningful to procurement but not open-ended.

Karthik
Director, Reliability Engineering

-----Original Message-----
From: Asha Reddy <asha@starlend.com>
Sent: Friday, April 2, 2027 09:12 AM
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Subject: Intermittent tail latency + renewal conversation

(Quoted for context)

From: Asha Reddy <asha@starlend.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@starlend.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 14:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent tail latency + renewal conversation

Thanks Soojin / Karthik — that all sounds reasonable. Procurement asked for two clarifications before they sign off: 1) the stipend amount (they asked for a concrete dollar figure tied to the incident impact); and 2) a short contract clause we can include in the renewal that explicitly references the targeted routes and the revised P99 SLO.

We're under a hard decision deadline of 2027-04-15 for our renewal committee. If you can send a draft stipend number and the SLA amendment this week, we can route internally. Also, please include any performance dashboards we'll rely on to validate the SLO after the pilot.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

- Asha

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Reddy <asha@starlend.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent tail latency + renewal conversation

Asha — attaching a formal packet for your committee: stipend_proposal_v1.pdf and sla_amendment_draft.docx (see attachments). Summary below:

- Proposed reliability stipend: $72,500 one-time credit applied to renewal invoice. Rationale: we calculated four weeks of impacted estimated unit costs based on your 30-day average token volume and incident uplift.
- Pilot offer: 30-day Dedicated pilot at a 20% pilot discount (net pass-through ~$36k) + $4,500 onboarding for monitoring hooks.
- Contract language (excerpt): "Redwood Inference will target P99 latency <= 650ms for the routes listed in Appendix A. Should Redwood fail to meet the revised P99 SLO for more than two (2) non-overlapping 4-hour windows within any 30-day period, StarLend will be eligible for service credits equivalent to 5% of that month's invoice, in addition to the one-time stipend."

Neha has also provisioned a dashboard access link (private) and will backfill monitoring queries into the shared Drive folder.

Next steps:
1) Asha/Liam: confirm acceptance of stipend amount and pilot terms by 2027-04-12.
2) On acceptance: sign DocuSign token for the amendment (I'll send the link).
3) We'll schedule a 60-min kickoff with Karthik's team within 48 hours of signature.

Thanks — attaching: stipend_proposal_v1.pdf, sla_amendment_draft.docx

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai

Attachments: stipend_proposal_v1.pdf; sla_amendment_draft.docx
